classifications.migrate-later: An active legacy contract that a later phase renames; the compatibility contract must understand both spellings until Phase 5 retires the old one.
classifications.alias-sla: An active legacy contract that stays valid as an alias for the whole compatibility window; the AGRO spelling wins a conflict.
classifications.retained-generic: A name that is internal, generic, or historical and is not renamed by the migration.
classifications.obsolete: A retired contract that only appears in guards, history, or tests asserting its absence; a prefix rename must never reactivate it.

OH_HOME.note: Registry home; resolved through resolveUserStateHome since Phase 0.

OH_PROJECT_ROOT.note: Image ENV and entrypoint anchor for /home/sandbox/harness; CLI reads go through the alias resolver.

OH_SANDBOX_IMAGE.note: Compose interpolation key and CLI override; the CLI read is aliased, the compose key is renamed with the fresh defaults in Phase 2.

OH_PULL_POLICY.note: Compose interpolation key rendered from oh.json.

OH_REPO_DIR.note: Compose interpolation key for the checkout bind.

OH_HOME_MOUNT.note: Compose interpolation key for the home mount.

OH_IMAGE_SEED_SRC.note: Entrypoint seed source override; aliased since Phase 0.

OH_HOME_SEED_SRC.note: Baked-home seed override read by seed_home.

OH_COMPAT_SH.note: Test seam for the boot-safe adapter path; internal.

OH_BIN.note: Entrypoint override for the CLI executable name.

OH_PYTHON_KERNEL_HOME.note: Kernel home override; default lives under ~/.local/share/oh/.

OH_ASSET_ROOT.note: Build-time asset root for the isolated CLI bundle; not a runtime contract.

OH_BIN_DIR.note: Installer control; the AGRO alias ships with get-agro.sh in Phase 1.

OH_GITHUB_REPO.note: Installer source repository; canonical installation drops the source-build fallback in Phase 1.

OH_INSTALL_REF.note: Older alias of OH_GITHUB_REF; retires with the managed source-checkout installer.

OH_SKIP_EPILOGUE.note: Installer-internal handshake between install.sh and get-oh.sh.

OH_REPLACE.note: Managed source-checkout installer control; retires with install.sh under Q2.

OH_HERMES_SMOKE.note: CI smoke gate for disposable Hermes sandboxes.

OH_REGISTRY_CHECKOUT.note: Probe input naming a skills-registry checkout.

OH_CONFIG_FIELDS.note: TypeScript constant, not an environment variable.

OH_IMAGE_ONLY.note: Retired flavor flag; probes assert it never returns.

OH_PROVISION_DEFAULTS.note: Retired boot-time install gate; probes assert it never returns.

OH_CONFIG_DIR.note: Retired $HOME config surface; probes assert it never returns.

OH_CLOUD_CONFIG.note: Retired $HOME config surface; probes assert it never returns.

.oh/.note: Project control plane; both spellings resolve through resolveControlDir since Phase 0.

oh.json.note: Project config; both spellings resolve through resolveConfigFile since Phase 0.

.oh/.image-seeded.note: First-boot marker; the entrypoint recognizes either since Phase 0.

~/.oh/sandboxes/.note: Host sandbox registry; userStateMigrationSpec moves only this subtree.

~/.openharness.note: Legacy managed product checkout (install.sh). Never registry content; preserved until the operator authorizes cleanup (Q2).

/opt/oh-seed.note: Image seed; compat_seed_src selects the AGRO seed only when it is the sole seed.

/opt/oh-assets.note: Image-internal bundle inputs for the isolated CLI build and the entrypoint's compat adapter.

/opt/oh.note: Image-internal CLI install root symlinked to /usr/local/bin/oh.

~/.config/openharness/cloud.json.note: Cloud CLI stored settings; owned by the Cloud phase.

~/.local/share/oh/.note: Python kernel home and python-env.sh written by provision-python.sh.

.oh/scripts/get-oh.sh.note: Installer; Phase 1 adds get-agro.sh and keeps get-oh.sh through the SLA.

.oh/scripts/install.sh.note: Managed source-checkout installer; retired by Q2 without deleting existing checkouts.

@mifune/openharness.note: npm package; deprecated but usable through the SLA.

ghcr.io/mifunedev/openharness.note: Image name; legacy tags remain as intentional aliases.

openharness (sandbox identity).note: Fresh compose project/container default; existing identities stay mapped.
